home.introHeadline: A little care can open a world of possibility.
home.introText: Rooted in Christian faith and guided by compassion, our purpose is to stand alongside children, young people and women as they pursue education, wellbeing and opportunity.
home.heroText: Every child, young person and woman deserves the opportunity to thrive. Together, we can turn compassion into opportunities for a brighter future.
home.programmeText: From the classroom to the wider community, our focus is on people, their potential and the opportunities that help them thrive.
home.featureTitle: A brighter future begins with a chance to learn.
home.featureText: Learning resources, school engagement and thoughtful support can help ease the barriers that stand between children and their potential.
home.evidenceTitle: Meaningful change deserves an honest story.
home.evidenceText: Behind every activity is a person, a purpose and a responsibility to share progress with care. Explore the priorities that guide our work and the learning that helps us grow.
home.involvementTitle: Good things happen when we care together.
home.involvementText: Your time, your skills, your ideas. There are many ways to help create opportunities. Find the path that feels right for you.
home.finalTitle: Be part of someone’s brighter future.
home.finalText: Let’s turn compassion into action, one person at a time.

about.vision: To produce agents of change who in turn will transform the world.

about.mission: Inspired by Christian faith and compassion, we work with children, young people and women to overcome barriers to education, wellbeing and opportunity through practical support, prevention and empowerment.

founderNote.label: Founder’s Note
founderNote.headline: Every life holds a world of possibility.
founderNote.text: Our vision begins with a simple belief: every person has something valuable to offer. Through care, education and the strength of community, we hope to create room for children, young people and women to discover their potential. Thank you for sharing in that hope and helping turn compassion into action.
